private_objects.name: LABEL_ENGINE_URL
private_objects.purpose: Base URL for LabelEngine — from LABEL_ENGINE_URL env var, default http://localhost:8050.

private_objects.name: PREFERENCE_STORE_URL
private_objects.purpose: Base URL for PreferenceStore — from PREFERENCE_STORE_URL env var, default http://localhost:8060.

private_objects.name: CALENDAR_CONNECTOR_URL
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Base URL for CalendarConnector — from CALENDAR_CONNECTOR_URL env var, default empty string. Empty string means calendar sync is disabled.

private_objects.name: ATLAS_BASE_URL
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Base URL for Atlas deep links — from ATLAS_BASE_URL env var, default https://workout.linspad.net. Used to construct the task deep link in calendar event descriptions.

private_objects.name: _label_client
private_objects.purpose: Return a configured httpx.Client targeting LABEL_ENGINE_URL with 5s timeout — unchanged.

private_objects.name: _preference_client
private_objects.purpose: Return a configured httpx.Client targeting PREFERENCE_STORE_URL with 5s timeout — unchanged.

private_objects.name: _calendar_client
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Return a configured httpx.Client targeting CALENDAR_CONNECTOR_URL with 5s timeout. Pattern mirrors _label_client() and _preference_client(). Caller is responsible for checking CALENDAR_CONNECTOR_URL is non-empty before calling this.

private_objects.name: _sync_calendar_event
private_objects.purpose: [NEW] Best-effort calendar sync helper. If CALENDAR_CONNECTOR_URL is empty, returns immediately. action='create': POST /api/calendar/events with atlas_event_id=task_id, title='[Atlas] '+title, start_at=scheduled_at.isoformat(), end_at=(scheduled_at+1day).isoformat(), all_day=True, description='Atlas task: {ATLAS_BASE_URL}/tasks/{task_id}\n\n{description or ""}'. action='update': PATCH /api/calendar/events/{task_id} with the same fields. action='delete': DELETE /api/calendar/events/{task_id}. All httpx exceptions (ConnectError, TimeoutException, etc.) and non-2xx responses are caught and logged as log.warning with status code and body. Never raises. Must be called after DB commit.

private_objects.name: create_task
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] POST /api/tasks — validates and inserts task. After conn.commit(), if body.status == 'scheduled', calls _sync_calendar_event(task_id, body.title, scheduled_at_date, body.description, 'create'). scheduled_at_date is body.scheduled_at parsed from the ISO string to a Python date object (date.fromisoformat(body.scheduled_at)). Returns single-row Dataset.

private_objects.name: update_task
private_objects.purpose: [CHANGED] PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id} — partial update. Pre-update snapshot fetches status, scheduled_at, title, description from DB. After conn.commit(), evaluates calendar action: (1) new_status='scheduled' and old_status!='scheduled' → 'create'; (2) new_status='scheduled' or (new_status is None and old_status='scheduled') and (scheduled_at or title changed) → 'update'; (3) new_status!='scheduled' and old_status='scheduled' → 'delete'; (4) else → no-op. Calls _sync_calendar_event as appropriate. scheduled_at passed as Python date object. Returns single-row Dataset or 404.
